title: CoboundaryScoreV1
description: Host-side coboundary score result ranking candidate proposals against open obstruction cochains. AuthorityEffect: None.

proposal_id.description: Identifier or digest of the evaluated candidate proposal.

prior_residual_norm.description: Norm ||omega|| of open obstruction cochain prior to repair. Exact rational in canonical string form; a JSON number is a float in most readers and core-sorted-json-no-float-v1 refuses floats.

post_residual_norm.description: Norm ||omega - d alpha|| of residual cochain after repair. Exact rational in canonical string form.

residual_drop.description: Delta = ||omega|| - ||omega - d alpha||. Exact rational in canonical string form. Positive indicates progress.

structural_cost.description: Cost penalty c(alpha) >= 0 for new primitives, arity, assumptions. Exact rational in canonical string form.

normalized_efficiency.description: s(alpha) = Delta / (1 + c(alpha)). Exact rational in canonical string form; null when the proposal is illegal, which does not rank at all.

is_legal.description: Whether the proposal passed all hard legality fences.

refusal_reason.description: Refusal code if illegal, else null.

is_exact_candidate.description: True only if post_residual_norm is exactly 0 over Q and dual_witness_ref is valid. Never decided by a tolerance.

dual_witness_ref.description: SHA-256 digest of verified dual-witness certificate if Exact.

authority_effect.description: Const None. Scores never confer execution or promotion authority.
